    Kronecker pairs from two extensions #

    Morphisms of representations commute with path operators (Rep.Hom.tot_comp_pathTot), so a representation with two jointly injective maps to representations respecting the relations of the cover respects them too (respectsCover_of_two). For a Kronecker pair (P, Q₀; z₁, z₂), the extensions E(z_c) (spaces Q₀(i) × P(i), arrows (q, p) ↦ (Q₀(α) q + z_c(α) p, P(α) p)) receive such maps from the generic objects L(S₋) and L(P₁). Hence, if both extensions respect the relations, so do the generic objects (respectsCover_generic): a Kronecker pair needs only the two module structures E(z₁), E(z₂).
